lado_card.texto: For the Horizonte Distribuidora customer service team: script, exercises, rubric and follow-up.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · part of Professional 2030 · inema.club · The INEMA certification is a qualification, not a regulated profession. · This course's page on INEMA.CLUB · Guide: how to learn AI

inicio.titulo: AI Trainer: teach teams to delegate, review and approve work done with AI
inicio.lead: For people who will run workshops and bootcamps and train teams and leaders using INEMA's open content. You learn how to teach adults, diagnose the class, build the workshop, train the right habit, teach safety with real cases and assess who learned.
inicio.capa_alt: Small training room with a flipchart, chairs in a semicircle and a facilitator pointing at the board.
inicio.aulas_sub: Each lesson ends with one piece of your kit. In lesson 8 you put it all together for the Horizonte Distribuidora customer service team.

itens: People who will run AI workshops or bootcamps for company teams and leaders.
Managers and HR, T&D or operations professionals who became the in-house AI reference.
Consultants who want to add on-the-job training, with a method and no miracle promises.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Plan a lesson using 5 principles of adult learning.
Diagnose the class and build a 1-hour, 4-hour or bootcamp workshop.
Train the habit of delegating, reviewing and approving, adapted to each learner's area.
Teach safety with real cases and assess the class with a 4-level rubric.
This course is part of Professional 2030. Each program will have INEMA certification; details soon.
Company used in the exercises: Horizonte Distribuidora Lab.
